options.name: api_key_encoded
options.description: API key credentials which is the Base64-encoding of the UTF-8\ representation of the id and api_key joined by a colon (:). Supported from Elastic 8+. See [Create API Key](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/security-api-create-api-key.html) documentation for specifics.

options.name: auth_method
options.description: Authentication Method.

options.name: auth_scheme
options.description: Authentication scheme.

options.name: cafile
options.description: Path to ca file

options.name: connection_options
options.description: Additional connection options for Elasticsearch

options.name: defer_validation
options.description: When true, deferrable validations are not run.

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the transform job.

options.name: dest
options.description: The destination for the transform.

options.name: frequency
options.description: The interval between checks for changes in the source indices when the transform is running continuously. Also determines the retry interval in the event of transient failures while the transform is searching or indexing.

options.name: latest
options.description: The latest method transforms the data by finding the latest document for each unique key.

options.name: login_hosts
options.description: The Elastic hosts to connect to. Can accept hostnames or URLs. If a hostname then values\ login_port and login_scheme will be used to construct a URL.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate with. Required when I(login_user) is specified.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The Elastic server port to login to.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The Elastic user to login with. Required when I(login_password) is specified.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the transform job

options.name: pivot
options.description: The pivot method transforms the data by aggregating and grouping it. These objects define the group by fields and the aggregation to reduce the data.

options.name: settings
options.description: Defines optional transform settings.

options.name: source
options.description: The source of the data for the transform.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the transform job

options.name: sync
options.description: Defines the properties transforms require to run continuously.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Response timeout in seconds.
